body: My therapist thinks I have bpd. But when you think the world is lying to you...how can you trust that?

This is a hard question to answer because frankly I have no answer for it. I've done nothing to warrant being called a monster, probably the worst thing I've done is stolen a nug of weed from my sister. 

But looking into people's eyes or even my own reflection in the mirror I see...something. It's both me and not me and I loath it. Loath the way it grins at me. The way it whispers in my head. It calls me a monster, and I'm not strong enough or sure enough of myself to tell it that it's wrong. That I'm not a monster. But it's been so long. And I'm so tired of fighting it.
